Q5844.reason: EWS/track-and-trigger applies to acutely unwell surgical patients and those after major surgery; the other options wrongly limit it by age, ED, or prior ICU/HDU stay.

Q5849.reason: Saying the records were kept in the regular course of business does not alone authenticate computer records or satisfy the business-records foundation; the court will require proof of the system’s reliability.

Q5853.reason: The shout is offered to show the customer was warned (notice/effect on the listener), so it is non-hearsay and relevant to contributory negligence; the owner already admitted the eel caused the fall.
